target.title: fix(ui): show cron job model selection
target.body: Related: #93507 ## What Problem This Solves Fixes an issue where users creating cron jobs from the Web UI quick-create flow could not choose a model, and existing cron jobs did not make their configured/default model visible in the job list/details. ## Why This Change Was Made This reuses the existing cron `payload.model` / Control UI `payloadModel` contract instead of adding runtime or schema behavior. The quick-create wizard now accepts the same model suggestions already loaded for the advanced cron form, maps the selected value into the cron form patch for agent-turn cron jobs, and scheduled agent jobs show either the configured model or an explicit default label in both the row chips and job detail section. Silent quick-create jobs save a `systemEvent` payload, so the model selector is hidden for that preset and the patch conversion does not emit `payloadModel` for silent jobs. ## User Impact Users can choose a model while creating a cron job from the guided Web UI flow, and can inspect scheduled agent jobs at a glance to see which model they will use. Jobs that use the default model now say so explicitly. Silent jobs no longer present a model choice that would be ignored during save. ## Evidence - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/ui/views/cron-quick-create.node.test.ts ui/src/ui/views/cron.test.ts ui/src/ui/controllers/cron.test.ts` passed: 3 files, 63 tests. - `node_modules\.bin\oxfmt.CMD --check ui\src\ui\views\cron-quick-create.ts ui\src\ui\views\cron-quick-create.node.test.ts ui\src\ui\views\cron.test.ts` passed. - `git diff --check` passed. - `PYTHONUTF8=1 python .agents\skills\autoreview\scripts\autoreview --mode commit --commit HEAD` passed with `autoreview clean: no accepted/actionable findings reported` on commit `62437b81f7d48c5a72ffcfeaad700d930b4bb57d`. - Added regression coverage that silent/systemEvent quick-create presets do not map `payloadModel` and do not render the quick-create model input. - Mocked Control UI / Playwright proof passed with the real Vite Control UI, a mocked Gateway, and system Chrome. Proof JSON: https://gist.github.com/ly85206559/d24a74e8dd7818dc34c1da6ba7d66a24 - Playwright proof confirmed the existing cron row and detail both show `Model: openai/gpt-5.2` for an agentTurn job. - Playwright proof confirmed the quick-create How step accepts `openai/gpt-5.5` and the captured `cron.add` request includes `payload.model: openai/gpt-5.5`. - Playwright proof reported `pageErrors: []`. - Local visual artifacts generated for inspection: `.artifacts/control-ui-e2e/cron-model-proof/01-job-list-model.png`, `.artifacts/control-ui-e2e/cron-model-proof/02-quick-create-model.png`, and `.artifacts/control-ui-e2e/cron-model-proof/page@5d408e05bab85b27a18d6dd4d4094162.webm`. ### Real non-mocked Gateway saved-flow proof - Local proof against a running `pnpm gateway:dev` instance (dev profile, `ws://127.0.0.1:19001`), with Gateway-hosted Control UI at `http://127.0.0.1:19001/cron` — not Playwright mock WS. - Proof command: `OPENCLAW_CRON_MODEL_GATEWAY_PROOF_EXTERNAL=1`, `OPENCLAW_CRON_MODEL_GATEWAY_PROOF_PROFILE=dev`, `node --import tsx scripts/repro/cron-model-ui-gateway-proof.mjs` on branch `codex/fix-cron-model-ui`. - `gatewayMode`: `real-non-mocked-external`. - CLI seed: persisted job `Saved model proof seed` with `payload.model: openai/gpt-5.2`; cron list row shows `Model: openai/gpt-5.2`. - UI quick-create: selected `openai/gpt-5.5` → real Control UI `cron.add` → `cron.list` confirms `payload.model: openai/gpt-5.5` for job `Quick create model proof`. - Reload: list and job detail still show `openai/gpt-5.5` after page reload. - Proof JSON: https://gist.github.com/ly85206559/b1a14621d6086d6cb0c31548d8bb28b3 - `pageErrors: []` in proof JSON.
